# FIRMS2 - Fire Information and Resource Management System

> > Global real-time fire detection and monitoring system powered by NASA satellite data (MODIS, VIIRS) with interactive mapping, data downloads, and alerting capabilities.

FIRMS2 is NASA's LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS) fire detection platform that processes thermal anomalies from multiple polar-orbiting satellites (NOAA-20, NOAA-21, S-NPP) and GOES geostationary data to provide wildfire monitoring and hotspot detection worldwide. The system offers both global coverage and regional tools for US/Canada fire tracking, with data available in multiple formats (shapefile, CSV, JSON) for research, emergency response, and resource management.

## Key Topics

- FIRMS (Fire Information and Resource Management System)
- MODIS and VIIRS satellite sensors
- NOAA-20, NOAA-21, S-NPP, JPSS-2 satellites
- Real-time fire detection and thermal anomalies
- LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS)
- Hotspot detection and wildfire monitoring
- Data download and archive access
- Geospatial data formats (shapefile, CSV, JSON)
- Collection-2 fire products
- US/Canada fire alerts and mapping
- Email notifications and alerting
- Burned area estimation
- University of Maryland
- NOAA and GOES integration

## Core Fire Detection & Mapping

- [FIRMS Global Fire Detection](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov): Global fire detection system with MODIS/VIIRS satellite data and email alerts
- [US/Canada Fire Alerts & Map](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/usfs): Real-time fire detection and alerts for US and Canada via interactive map

## Data Access & Downloads

- [Archive Download](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/download): Download fire data from MODIS/VIIRS in multiple formats with authentication

## News & Updates

- [What's New](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/content/notifications/firms/news.html): Updates on FIRMS Collection-2, GOES-19, and product improvements
